name: aperture-film
description: Devin launch video, direction 7: The Aperture Film (macOS in Devin Cloud)

scripts.frames:take: mkdir -p frames/take && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i assets/raw/silverroom-take.mp4 -ss 12.0 -t 15.45 -vf fps=30,scale=-2:1600 -fps_mode cfr frames/take/f%04d.png
scripts.encode: mkdir -p out && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -framerate 30 -i frames/out/f%05d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 16 -r 30 -movflags +faststart out/aperture-film.mp4
scripts.build: npm run frames:take && npm run render && npm run encode && npm run sheet
